resolution.note: Project PreToolUse gauge matcher covers Bash|Read|Glob|Grep; drift test ties it to refusesAtCeiling; live probe denied npm past the ceiling.

title: Gate Bash, Read, Glob and Grep with the live context ceiling
body: Defect: .claude/settings.json wires context-gauge.ts on PreToolUse only for Agent|Task|Workflow|WebFetch|WebSearch|NotebookEdit|Write|Edit, so the live ceiling never sees Bash, Read, Glob or Grep; the handoff-only Bash allowlist and bounded Read (#458) are proven only by the in-process replay. The host install (~/.claude/settings.json, #461) already matches Bash|Read|Glob|Grep.

Acceptance: the project PreToolUse gauge matcher covers Bash, Read, Glob and Grep; a test asserts every tool refusesAtCeiling decides on is in the project matcher; a live claude -p probe past the ceiling shows a Bash npm command denied.

Live probe (claude -p, Haiku, temporary autoCompactWindow 200000, context 218k): first Bash 'echo one' admitted, second Bash 'npm --version' denied with 'Context at 218k is past the 180k ceiling'. The first tool call of a fresh session has no usage in the transcript yet, so the gauge cannot gate it. Probe lesson: a live probe past the ceiling follows the denial into krn-handoff and launches a real successor; run such probes with --disallowedTools Skill.
